name: Hamilton
feasibility: spatial/services first; revenue/value blocked by missing open assessment roll
summary: Hamilton has strong ArcGIS Hub data for boundaries, roads, bikeways, transit, parking, zoning, and population geographies. The key missing piece is an open assessment roll with assessed value, class, and neighbourhood/account fields.
privacy: Hamilton/MPAC assessment roll data is not available as an open bulk dataset. Do not scrape tax calculators or address/roll lookup flows.

boundaries.title: Neighbourhoods
boundaries.licence: City of Hamilton Open Data Licence
boundaries.caveat: Observed feature count differed from description; add count guard.

assessment.title: No open Edmonton-equivalent assessment roll found
assessment.caveat: Parcel layer lacks assessed value, class, address, roll/account, and neighbourhood; Teranet/MPAC-derived licensing needs confirmation.

tax_rates.title: How Property Tax Rates are Calculated
tax_rates.caveat: Rates vary by former municipality/community, area-rated fire/transit class, and property class; needs tax-area mapping.

roads.title: Street Centreline
roads.licence: City of Hamilton Open Data Licence
roads.caveat: Page through 2,000-record server limit; filter city-owned/constructed if modeling city-maintained supply.

bike.title: Bikeways
bike.licence: City of Hamilton Open Data Licence
bike.caveat: High record count; filter existing and QA segmentation/deduping.

transit.title: HSR Bus Stops
transit.licence: City of Hamilton Open Data Licence
transit.caveat: Good stop layer; confirm current GTFS source for service-frequency metrics.

zoning.title: Zoning
zoning.caveat: Use Hamilton-specific classification; verify exact FeatureServer item before implementation.

population.title: Ward/neighbourhood census/profile data
population.caveat: Research found stronger ward-level coverage than neighbourhood-level; neighbourhood population may need Census dissemination-area apportionment.
